semiconductor_relevance: High — Atecom Technology Co., Ltd. specializes in manufacturing and supplying a wide range of semiconductor materials, making it a key player in the semiconductor value chain.
summary: Atecom Technology Co., Ltd. is a manufacturer and supplier of customized semiconductor materials, including various types of silicon and compound wafers. Established in 1998 in Taipei, Taiwan, the company focuses on providing advanced materials for applications in power devices, automotive EVs, and AI technologies.
capabilities: Customized silicon SOI and epitaxial wafers
Silicon carbide (SiC) and gallium nitride (GaN) wafers
Diverse substrate options including CZ, MCZ, and FZ silicon
Advanced materials for automotive and AI applications

regional_presence.Taiwan: The company is headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan, where it manufactures semiconductor materials.
